new_observables.rule:
(fixed here, recorded in new_obs_promotion.json):
  eligible = family with >= 2 distinct source episodes, representative layer in {A, B}, camera in {S, B} (or layer A with camera 'any'),
             no config.neutral_prompt_forbidden term in question/values, not a duplicate of an existing catalog question;
  rank     = distinct episodes desc, then distinct bound items desc, then cluster id; take the first MAX_PROMOTE (8); fewer than 5 -> stop and report.

promoted.description: Does trunk rotation decelerate before contact or continue accelerating through contact?
Height of the ball at the contact frame relative to the player's body.
Timing of split step landing relative to opponent contact: before opponent contact, at contact, or after contact.
At the start of forward swing, are the hips hinged back or pushed forward under upright shoulders?
At contact on low balls, how much are the knees flexed?
Wrist angle change: does the hitting wrist flex rapidly around contact instead of staying stable?
At the initiation of the forward swing, which body segment rotates toward the target first: shoulders or hips?

new_observables.note: question + values are copied verbatim from the family's representative candidate (model-written); no discriminator was invented; OBS-25 (shoulders vs hips first) overlaps in meaning with OBS-18 (which part starts first) and may collide with it - flagged for review

new_obs_cluster_list_v3.description: During the forward swing to contact, does the hitting elbow pull linearly across the torso or drive forward rotatably?
At the end of preparation, is the hitting hand positioned well below or level with the ball?
On a volley, does the racket take a backward swing behind the body or stay in front?
At address and swing, where is the hand positioned along the racket handle relative to the butt cap?
Joint flexion at hips, knees, and ankles during split-step landing or ready stance
Angle of racket face path through contact relative to horizontal
Spine curvature during preparation and swing: neutral flat spine or rounded thoracic spine.
During the follow-through, does the entire upper arm rotate upward or does the elbow stay low while the forearm turns?
During the forward swing, does the front knee collapse inward toward the midline or track over the toes?
At the start of the forward swing, does the front knee extend noticeably past the toes?
During forward swing and contact on a one-handed backhand, does the non-hitting arm extend backward as a counter-balance?
Stance width between feet during recovery or ready position
Foot contact area when landing from the split step
After follow-through, does the player maintain dynamic balance or stumble and brace against the court with the racket?
Direction of the hand and racket path through the hitting zone relative to target line
Through contact and release, does the player let the forearm roll over freely or push/slice across the ball?
At the start of the forward swing, does the hitting elbow/arm lag behind the coronal plane of the torso?
At contact on low balls, is the hitting elbow dropped noticeably below the hitting hand?
On an opponent serve, does the returner make racket contact or get cleanly aced?
At contact, is the front foot heel or entire front foot lifted off the court or grounded?
Angle between forearm and racket shaft during preparation
During the preparation and loading phase, is the rear foot collapsing into over-pronation on the inside heel or balanced on the forefoot?
During the forward swing and contact, does the hitting shoulder visibly elevate or shrug toward the ear?
During the forward swing into contact, does the spine display lateral side-bending with the hitting shoulder dipping lower than the non-hitting shoulder?
Direction of hitting elbow drive at forward swing initiation relative to chest orientation.
Within 0.5 s after contact, does the non-dominant foot kick upward or across the body?
At or before contact, does the lead foot stay planted or lift and twist open?
Vertical launch angle of the ball off the racket face at contact
Distance between feet during ready stance or movement initiation
At the moment the base is set, what is the stance width relative to shoulder width?
Forward extension of racket head through contact zone
During the forward swing drop, does the racket head lay back (flip) behind the hand before moving forward?
At the start of the forward swing, does the racket head drop below the hand into a dynamic lag position?
At the finish of the follow-through, is the hitting elbow elevated with racket head pointing downward?
At the follow-through finish, is the racket head tilted down below the hand or pointing upward?
Landing depth of the ball inside the opponent court
Depth of landing for off-center or shanked shots
Height of ball trajectory over the net
Racket head speed into the contact zone
Player court position relative to baseline at contact
Foot pressure point during ready position or recovery
Racket-forearm alignment during follow-through: does the racket maintain an angle with the forearm or straighten and flip past it?
On a swing attempt, does the racket completely miss the ball?
During the forward swing, does trunk rotation show smooth continuous flow or rigid, stiff movement?
At contact, how far has the chest rotated relative to the net?
At what point does the non-hitting hand release the racket throat on a one-handed backhand?
Height of the racket head at the highest point of the backswing loop relative to the player's shoulders.
At the apex of the backswing loop, height of the hitting hand relative to the player's shoulders.
At the forward swing on low balls, is the shoulder line tilted laterally (lateral spine flexion) or horizontal?
At contact on low balls, is the shoulder line tilted down toward the hitting side or horizontal?
At the start of the forward swing, does the racket drop below the ball before advancing?
Before the forward swing begins, does the racket drop below hand height into the slot?
